description: Binary assertions for /forge-job-map static structure check
test_input: job map for V-SMASH — what do operators hire it to do, desired outcomes and opportunity landscape

assertions.name: jtbd_job_statement
assertions.check: defines the job-to-be-done with verb + object + context
assertions.regex: JOB STATEMENT|job-to-be-done|JTBD|Action verb.*object.*context|The job is NOT the product

assertions.name: desired_outcomes
assertions.check: generates desired outcome statements in minimize/maximize format

assertions.name: odi_framework
assertions.check: references ODI / Outcome-Driven Innovation and Importance x Satisfaction

assertions.name: opportunity_algorithm
assertions.check: runs the Opportunity Algorithm / opportunity score

assertions.name: ceo_selection_core
assertions.check: job definition and strategy selection are CEO Core
assertions.regex: Core — CEO|CEO conducts|CEO decides|chọn strategy|Core \(C\)|interview OPERATORS

assertions.name: hoq_design_parameters
assertions.check: optional HOQ design parameter weights export for HELIX Phase 2

assertions.name: buyer_not_user
assertions.check: applies the buyer != user defense gotcha
